title: From Redundancy to Minimality: Fixed-Point-Guided Hierarchical Reduction of Learned Piecewise-Linear Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2610.01369v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Understanding a nonlinear dynamical system from time series requires not only reproducing its trajectories, but also identifying a simple representation that preserves its essential dynamical structure. Almost-linear recurrent neural networks (AL-RNNs) are piecewise-linear RNNs in which only a subset of units use ReLU nonlinearities, so that nonlinear capacity is explicitly controlled by the number of ReLU units. Their activation patterns define linear regions, represented as symbols, whose observed transitions form a symbolic transition graph. We ask whether an AL-RNN with more ReLU units can instead be trained first and systematically reduced to a minimal dynamical representation. translated_title: 从冗余到极简：不动点引导的学得分段线性动力学的层次化约简
translated_abstract: 从时间序列理解非线性动力系统不仅需要再现其轨迹，还需要识别出一种能保留其本质动力学结构的简单表示。近线性循环神经网络（AL-RNN）是一类分段线性RNN，其中只有一部分单元使用ReLU非线性，因此其非线性能力由ReLU单元的数量显式控制。这些网络的激活模式定义了线性区域，线性区域被表示为符号，其观测到的转移构成一个符号转移图。然而，直接训练具有少量ReLU单元的AL-RNN以实现极简的动力学表示往往不可靠。我们提出这样的问题：能否先训练一个具有较多ReLU单元的AL-RNN，再将其系统地约简为极简的动力学表示。我们引入了一种不动点引导的层次化约简程序，该程序逐步线性化所选的ReLU单元，合并相邻的线性区域……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出一种不动点引导的层次化约简方法，通过逐步线性化ReLU单元，将已训练的、含较多冗余ReLU单元的近线性循环神经网络系统性地约简为保留本质动力学结构的极简分段线性表示。
en_tdlr: A fixed-point-guided hierarchical reduction procedure progressively linearizes ReLU units in trained almost-linear RNNs, systematically reducing redundant piecewise-linear dynamics into a minimal representation that preserves the essential dynamical structure.
